newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish 1996 building starts rose 15 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Finnish 1996 building starts rose 15 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Finnish building starts in 1996 rose to 28 million cubic metres, up 15 percent on the previous year, Statistics Finland (SF) said on Friday.
The volume of 1996 housing starts increased 26 percent on 1995, and in the fourth quarter of 1996 housing starts rose 54 percent on the year-ago period, SF said.
Industrial building starts fell 10 percent in 1996, with the decline steepening to 18 percent in the fourth quarter, SF said.
Public service building starts grew 70 percent in 1996, but slowed to three percent growth in the fourth quarter.
Agricultural construction starts rose 44 percent in 1996, SF said.
Commercial and office building starts fell 10 percent in 1996, but swung to 60 percent growth in the fourth quarter, SF said.
